note: POOL SEQUENCE TEST (only with &seq=1). The swipe on from 'from' is the first blow; the shots then come down by themselves, each one a sledgehammer. Per shot: 'hold' = ms until the next blow lands; 'weight' = how hard (1 = normal); 'side' = which way the window twists (1 or -1); 'dir' = which way it is knocked [x, y]. Every blow: 'strike' = px the window is knocked; 'twist' = degrees it is twisted; 'drive' = how hard the near things are punched at the viewer through the depth; 'shudder' = how hard they jar sideways; 'blowout' = how far the picture blows out (0 = not at all); 'thud' = the impact sound on or off; 'thudVolume' 0 to 1; 'thudFile' = a sound file in the SoundScape folder to use instead of the made one (null = the made one). 'firstCut' = ms of the cut from 013 into 014; 'firstPush' = how far 013 pushes in as it goes.
